turns.content: Racemic 3-methylpent-1-ene undergoes self-metathesis with a Grubbs catalyst. Identify the non-ethene product skeleton whose distinct stereoisomers must be counted.
Give a counting method that treats stereocentre pairings, interchangeability of the two product ends, and E/Z alkene geometry separately.
State the stereochemical composition at the starting alkene's existing stereogenic centre.
List the formal stereochemical pairings implied by the sample composition before applying symmetry equivalences.
Using the sample composition established above, account for interchangeability of the two product ends and count the distinct configuration pairings.
For each remaining pairing, include the geometry available to the newly formed unsaturation and determine the total number of products.
Check the count against the sample composition, catalyst behaviour, end interchangeability, configuration, and geometry of the new unsaturation.
Report the number of distinct non-ethene products and summarize the stereochemical and geometric enumeration.
